projects.title: Sparrow
projects.description: Sparrow is a local, tool-enabled Telegram assistant designed for autonomous operation with basic protections for data security. It runs entirely on your machine, operates inside a scoped workspace, and can manage files, Git workflows, and external tools while enforcing tiered approvals for higher-risk actions.

projects.title: Space-Xplorer
projects.description: Space-Xplorer is an interactive web application that enables users to create personalized profiles, search specific locations, and receive detailed star charts, five-day weather forecasts, and information on visible celestial objects tailored to their area. The app also allows users to save and favorite their searches for easy access and future reference.

projects.title: Tarkine
projects.description: Tarkine is a vanilla HTML, CSS and Javascript web-based game, featuring a story-driven puzzle adventure where players navigate to safety after a plane crash. Players must locate items, solve puzzles, and make crucial choices to escape the forest. This was my first project in a team setting during my coding bootcamp.
